title: _is_streaming_sink_error is a pure pass-through alias of _is_streaming_compatibility_error
description: _is_streaming_sink_error(exc) does nothing but `return _is_streaming_compatibility_error(exc)`. It carries no sink-specific logic and its only caller (bounded_sink, line 256) could call _is_streaming_compatibility_error directly. The separate name implies sink-specific detection that does not exist, and any future divergence would have to be added deliberately anyway. Collapsing the alias removes a misleading indirection (and centralises the fix for the substring-heuristic finding above).
evidence: Lines 47-48: `def _is_streaming_sink_error(exc: BaseException) -> bool:` / `    return _is_streaming_compatibility_error(exc)`. Sole reference is bounded_sink line 256 `if not _is_streaming_sink_error(exc):`.
